result.summary: The food-delivery home screen renders mostly correctly, but there are several visual defects: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, third card text clipped at the screen edge, an inconsistent favorite-heart button style between the two 'Popular right now' cards, missing rating info on the carousel cards, and the second popular card being cut off by the bottom nav with no visible title.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice with identical image, time (15–25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90), which looks like duplicated/erroneous data.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by ID before rendering, or verify the data source for repeated entries.

issues.description: The third carousel card ('Smash Bros Bu…') has its title and image clipped by the viewport edge with no partial-peek padding, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek amount so the next card is partially visible in a deliberate way, and truncate the title with an ellipsis inside the card width.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles — the first has a white circular background with dark outline, the second has a dark/translucent background with white outline — an inconsistent component state.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single style (e.g., white circle with dark heart) across all cards, using distinct fill only for the active/favorited state.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar and its name/metadata is not visible, so the page appears to end mid-component.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: Carousel cards in 'Fastest near you' omit rating information that is present on 'Popular right now' cards, making the two sections visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Include rating (and cuisine tag) on carousel cards, or intentionally align both card variants to the same metadata set.

issues.description: The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', ...) is clipped mid-chip at the right edge and gives no visual affordance (fade/arrow) that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or scroll indicator at the edge of the horizontally scrollable filter row.

issues.description: Placeholder-looking gray gradient thumbnails with clip-art plates in the 'Fastest near you' cards read as missing images compared to the richer imagery elsewhere.
issues.suggestion: Use real restaurant photos or a consistent branded fallback image treatment for all cards.
